## Objective
- Make a playable Korean dark-fantasy RPG prototype with progression, combat, and special abilities inspired by anime power-fantasy games.

## Requirements
- Build a complete playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Original request described a Roblox game.

## Decisions
- The existing project is a Korean browser-based action RPG prototype, **그림자 각성 — 균열의 사냥꾼**, not a Roblox Studio project.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` and `style.css` provide the game interface and responsive styling.
- `game.js` now includes combat, skills, enemy AI, progression, rendering, UI updates, keyboard/mouse/mobile input, and the game loop.
- `node --check game.js` passes.
- Opened the game at `http://localhost:3002`; browser snapshot shows the expected interface and game HUD.

### Active
- Fix and verify the browser presentation. The page currently renders the interface elements as full-width stacked blocks; computed `.topbar` position is `static` despite the CSS file loading with HTTP 200.
- Recheck gameplay and capture/inspect a screenshot after resolving styling.

### Blocked
- Browser visual verification is incomplete: the computed layout does not match the CSS declarations, and the screenshot could not be inspected as a valid game view.
- Browser console reported only a missing `/favicon.ico` (404), which is likely incidental.

## Next Move
1. Investigate why loaded `style.css` rules are not reflected in computed styles; fix the CSS loading/parsing/layout issue.
2. Reload the page and confirm the HUD overlays the canvas as intended.
3. Exercise movement, attack, skills, progression, and mobile controls; inspect a fresh screenshot.
4. Briefly report the browser-game assumption and controls when finished.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, rendering, controls, combat, and progression.
- `index.html`: Game interface and canvas.
- `style.css`: Responsive game layout and styling.
- `screenshots/game.png`: Current browser capture; needs rechecking after layout fix.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Chromium is installed; the local server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- `game.js` syntax check passes; game was loaded in browser and showed the expected title and interface content.
